[EN] I've managed to sneak this far, but I think they may have noticed me. We'll see.

Just be careful.
[ES] He conseguido escabullirme hasta aquí, pero creo que puede que me hayan visto. Ya veremos.

Solo ten cuidado.

[EN] You need to be careful. Grab the weapon tightly.Ready for Battle!
[ES] Debes tener cuidado. Grab the weapon tightly.Ready for Battle!
